questions.question: The Ministry of Coal amended the Mineral Concession Rules, 1960, to increase the recognition period for exploration and mining plan preparation agencies to how many years?
questions.explanation: The Ministry of Coal amended the Mineral Concession Rules, 1960, extending the recognition period for recognized exploration agencies and mining plan preparation agencies from three to five years.
